body:
24 AI agents ran overnight. One draft PR by breakfast. Zero writes to main.
AI agent guardrails are the whole product: these are the 5 things my agents are banned from doing.

1. Never write to main. Every agent opens a pull request, I merge.
2. Never delete anything. Not a file, not a row.
3. Never post without my tap. They draft, I approve from my phone.
4. Never pay, never message a person, unless I asked for that exact thing.
5. My data never leaves this PC. Emails, clients, numbers, never in a search box.
Anyone can run 24 agents. Few can sleep while they do.

I'm Manraj Sidhu, AI developer, and this is the real build.
